kernels: k_scatter_v2: dense scatter into band-local internal planes; B_geo written for every positive overlap BEFORE the value check so a nonfinite source sample keeps geometric support

k_fold_accumulate_v2: one thread per native pixel folds scale^2 subpixels per channel into per-frame candidates; full-stream A/B/B2, covB/covB2, conf S/C stream stats, support masks (u16: geo bits 0..3, src bits 4..7), footprint, bounded hash reservoir

k_finalize_v2: bit-exact gate-3 clip port per (pixel, channel): (x,order) insertion sort, cumulative-weight median at >= total/2, (|x-med|,order) MAD order, asymmetric bounds, early stop; gate-4 confidence states; deterministic overflow fallback
implementation.reservoir: record 32 B (x, b, frame_order, sigma2); slots = 2*R = 128 absorb the binomial hash-keep tail; kept > slots degrades the pixel to reservoir_overflow_fallback (uniform value, support kept) - deterministic and observable
implementation.workspace: one cudaMalloc batch inside reserve(); events per frame (up0/up1/k0/k1) on a dedicated non-blocking stream; accumulate_frame enqueues upload+memset+scatter+fold fully async with zero syncs and zero allocations; finalize runs the finalize kernel, ONE stream sync, and the result+telemetry download
